description: rewrite_rules[*].reject literal substrings — each match attributed to its rule_id.
brand_voice_yaml:
voice:
  name: "Coroboros"
  last_updated: "2026-04-27"
  source: "manual"

forbidden_lexicon: []

rewrite_rules:
  - reject: "It might be worth considering..."
    accept: "Use X."
    rule_id: no-hedging-imperative
  - reject: "significantly faster"
    accept: "<cite a number>"
    rule_id: specific-over-abstract-speed
  - reject: "Great question — let me explain."
    accept: "<delete entire opener>"
    rule_id: no-salesperson-opener

sentence_norms:
  word_count_min: 8
  word_count_max: 18
  sentence_max_hard: 25
input:
# Reply draft

Great question — let me explain.

It might be worth considering... a different layout.

The new pipeline is significantly faster than the previous one.
